name: Elevation
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign act of creation, exemplified in the finishing of the heavens and the earth and the formation of man from the dust, who was then given life by God's breath, signifying man's unique elevation as a living soul in God's likeness. The subtlety of the serpent in the garden introduces the tension between divine order and rebellion. Additionally, God's power is demonstrated in the natural world, as He suspends the earth over nothing and controls the rain, illustrating His ultimate authority over all elevation and sustenance.
